title: Zesty Smoky Indian Paneer Tikka
description: A smoky and springy weeknight Indian dish featuring peppers and paneer, perfect for a high-protein meal. This recipe is a Gujarati-inspired take on the classic paneer tikka.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, and smoked paprika.
Add the paneer, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, and onion to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the yogurt mixture.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the bowl from the refrigerator and thread the marinated paneer and vegetables onto skewers.
Brush the skewers with vegetable oil and season with salt.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the paneer is golden brown and the vegetables are tender.
While the skewers are baking, heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the remaining marinade for a few minutes, or until it thickens slightly.
Serve the paneer tikka hot with the thickened marinade spooned over the top.
